Design process

The Flowmelon way
From first sketch to handoff

Every design follows the same clear system. From the first brief to the final Figma handoff, each stage keeps the work focused, on-brand and ready to build in Webflow.

1

Discovery & Brief

We learn your goals, audience and brand, then agree on scope, sitemap and success metrics.

2

Wireframes & Structure

Low-fidelity layouts map the user journey and page hierarchy before any visual design starts.

3

UI Design in Figma

Every page and breakpoint designed with real content, motion notes and reusable components.

4

Prototype & Feedback

Interactive prototypes let your team and clients review the flow and sign off with confidence.

5

Design System

Colors, type, spacing and components documented so the build stays consistent as it grows.

6

Handoff & Support

A build-ready Figma file annotated for Webflow, plus support while the site is developed.

Marketing websites, landing pages, product and SaaS sites, eCommerce storefronts and the design systems behind them — all in Figma, ready for Webflow.

It depends on scope. A landing page and a full multi-page site are very different projects, so we quote after a short call and a look at your brief. Most site designs land between $4,000 and $15,000 — with a clear price before we start.

Yes. We design inside your guidelines and extend them for the web — states, motion, responsive rules and any missing components.

Every project includes structured review rounds. We share direction early with moodboards and a key page, so feedback lands while it’s cheap to change.

A kickoff call, a feedback session per milestone and quick async comments in Figma. Most clients spend around an hour a week with us.
